name: pipeline_stuck_ro_triage
description: Workflow used to detect and prioritize roster operations that are stalled within the processing pipeline.
procedure_steps: Select records where the IS_STUCK flag equals 1
Order records by stage processing duration to highlight longest delays
Evaluate health indicators across different pipeline stages
Flag operations with Red health status as highest priority
Aggregate results by organization and state for operational visibility
expected_outputs: Collection of roster operations currently stuck in the pipeline
application_context: Operational teams run this procedure to diagnose pipeline slowdowns and determine which roster operations require immediate remediation.
